description: Fast Cables Limited is a Pakistani manufacturer of electrical cables and conductors that has expanded from cable manufacture into metals, PVC and lighting businesses. It operates a manufacturing unit at Raiwind, Lahore, and describes itself as the leading manufacturer of electric cables and conductors in the country.
headOffice: 192-Y, Commercial Area, DHA Phase III, Lahore, Pakistan
